meta.name: agent-browser
meta.description: Connects to Oxylabs remote agent browsers over the Chrome DevTools Protocol (CDP) with Playwright or Puppeteer. Built-in anti-detection, residential proxies, geo-targeting, persistent sessions and profiles, session recording and live VNC inspection for debugging. Use instead of WebFetch or a local browser whenever a site renders with JavaScript, blocks bots (DataDome, Cloudflare, Akamai), needs a real browser session, screenshots or PDFs. Covers connection, retries, error recovery and safe scraping of protected targets without any human help.

copy.tagline: 让程序用真实浏览器抓取 JavaScript 网站与被反爬保护的页面
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果需要稳定抓取被反爬保护或强依赖 JS 的网页。
copy.tagline_en: Turn JS-heavy, bot-protected pages into scrapable data with a real browser
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to scrape JavaScript-heavy or bot-protected sites reliably.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会连上 Oxylabs 的远程 Chrome 会话（通过 CDP），用 Playwright 或 Puppeteer 驱动，抓取需 JavaScript 渲染或被反爬拦截的页面，产出正文、截图或 PDF。
howto.when: 当目标站点需要 JavaScript 渲染、被 DataDome、Cloudflare、Akamai 等反爬拦截，或需要真实浏览器会话、截图与 PDF 时，改用它替代 WebFetch 或本地浏览器。

howto.what_en: After install, Claude connects to Oxylabs remote Chrome sessions over CDP and drives them with Playwright or Puppeteer, fetching JavaScript-rendered or bot-blocked pages and returning page content, screenshots or PDFs.
howto.when_en: Use it instead of WebFetch or a local browser when a site renders with JavaScript, blocks bots such as DataDome, Cloudflare or Akamai, or needs a real browser session, screenshots or PDFs.
